title: Deep Sets
supports: Permutation-invariant set functions; Theorem 2 countable-universe restriction. Does not prove simple averaging sufficient for bearing diagnosis.

title: Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning
supports: Bag-level supervision and permutation-invariant aggregation; not proof of cross-modal time alignment.

title: A Kernel Two-Sample Test
supports: Population MMD with characteristic kernels distinguishes distributions; simple finite-dimensional means need not. Distribution equality does not identify temporal coupling.

title: Soft-DTW: a Differentiable Loss Function for Time-Series
supports: Differentiable monotonic sequence alignment robust to time shifts/dilations; does not solve sensor transfer functions or establish true mechanical correspondences.

title: Lecture 9: Fourier Transform Properties
supports: Time shift multiplies Fourier transform by unit-modulus linear phase. Finite cropping/gaps and signed DCT are not covered by a blanket magnitude-invariance claim.

title: envspectrum: Envelope spectrum for machinery diagnosis
supports: Bearing BPFO repetition versus high-frequency impact resonance; modulated envelope and spectrum examples.

title: Rolling Element Bearing Fault Diagnosis
supports: Envelope and bearing fault frequencies; constant shaft speed does not need order tracking in that specific example.

title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
supports: Accuracy/risk must be reported alongside coverage when rejecting examples.

title: Leakage and the Reproducibility Crisis in ML-based Science
supports: Taxonomy and methodological implications of leakage; does not diagnose this dataset without source-code audit.

title: Linear Prediction for Time Series
supports: Weak stationarity and autocovariance definition; finite-mean-variance derivation in report is our own.
